title: Framework materials for nuclear waste treatment
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6CS00154H, Review Article
Mengjie Hao, Xiaolu Liu, Yinghui Xie, Hanzhi Chen, He Gu, Chuanlei Luo, Muliang Xiao, Xinyue Zhang, Jiaqi Li, Xinyi Yang, Juyao Zhang, Hui Yang, Fuyou Fan, Juncheng Liang, Xiangke Wang
This review comprehensively summarizes and discusses recent advances in framework materials for nuclear waste treatment, covering key aspects of materials design, synthesis, performance, and fundamental structure–property–function relationships.
